lines.rookie: A theatre is THEATRUM in Latin. Look at your notes again.
lines.junior: In Latin, a theatre is THEATRUM. Look at your notes again.
lines.master: THEATRUM is the Latin for a theatre, and that is not the word in your notes. Look again.

lines.rookie: Check your spelling on Aldo's Latin card.
lines.junior: Check your spelling against Aldo's Latin card.
lines.master: Compare your spelling, letter by letter, with Aldo's Latin card.

lines.rookie: A Roman library? Under the square?
lines.junior: A Roman library? Right under the square?
lines.master: A Roman library? Hidden beneath the square?

lines.rookie: BIBLIOTHECA. A room for books, on the old map.
lines.junior: BIBLIOTHECA. It's a room for books, marked on the old map.
lines.master: BIBLIOTHECA: a room for books, marked on the ancient map.

lines.rookie: Then the concrete must not come.
lines.junior: Then the concrete must not be poured.
lines.master: Then not a drop of concrete can be poured.

lines.rookie: I am bringing the city inspector tomorrow!
lines.junior: I'll bring the city inspector tomorrow!
lines.master: I'm bringing the city inspector first thing tomorrow!

lines.rookie: But without the real piece, who will believe us?
lines.junior: But without the real piece, who's going to believe us?
lines.master: But without the real piece, who on earth will believe us?
